project_detail.title: Intelligent Cart State Detection
project_detail.description: A real-time video analytics system for detecting and tracking the state of shopping carts using advanced computer vision techniques and optimized sampling strategies.
project_detail.overview_p1: This project demonstrates an intelligent video analytics system for real-time detection and tracking of shopping cart states in retail environments. The system employs advanced computer vision algorithms and optimized video frame sampling techniques to efficiently analyze cart occupancy levels.
project_detail.overview_p2: By leveraging state-of-the-art object detection models like YOLOv8 and robust tracking algorithms, the system can reliably monitor multiple carts simultaneously, even in challenging real-world scenarios. The customizable region of interest (ROI) feature allows for focused analysis in specific areas of the video frame.
project_detail.overview_p3: The system provides detailed analytics and intuitive visualizations, enabling store managers to gain valuable insights into customer behavior and optimize store operations. With its cross-platform compatibility and scalable architecture, the solution can be easily integrated into existing retail systems.

crps_detail.title: CRPS - Real-Time Facial Recognition System
crps_detail.description: A comprehensive real-time facial recognition system that combines advanced computer vision techniques and vector databases to efficiently identify and search for faces in surveillance, access control, and user authentication scenarios.
crps_detail.overview_p1: This project implements a cutting-edge facial recognition system that addresses the challenges of fast and accurate face identification in real-world scenarios. The system handles various factors such as different facial angles, occlusions, varying lighting conditions, and the need to match faces against a large dataset of known identities.
crps_detail.overview_p2: The solution combines state-of-the-art techniques: YuNet for precise face detection even in challenging conditions, FaceNet for generating robust facial embeddings invariant to pose and lighting, and Weaviate as a vector database optimized for similarity search. This architecture ensures both accuracy and efficiency in real-time operations.
crps_detail.overview_p3: With an intuitive PyQt graphical interface, encrypted data storage for security, and multi-threaded processing for real-time performance, the system provides a comprehensive solution suitable for surveillance systems, access control, and user authentication applications.
features: Graphical user interface built with PyQt
